cards.mood: The piece opens with a fragile, introspective melancholy, establishing a sense of vulnerability through sparse instrumentation.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a rich, resonant baritone that possesses a slightly raspy, textured quality.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic backbone, playing arpeggiated figures in the verses and shifting to broad, sustained chords in the choruses.
